issues.body: The re-export comment says the per-path descriptor is "AXIS-2 only; AXIS-1 stays SemiHonest" (around line 419), but equality_join_security now deliberately returns SecurityDescriptor::semi_honest_only(), which promotes no axis. The same stale claim appears in research/mpc-sparql-capability-matrix.md as "Tier reported AXIS-2-only". This contradicts the round-3 containment fix and continues to describe the externally unaudited path as carrying the output-guarantee promotion that the PR itself explains projects to active malicious security.
issues.fix_hint: Change both statements to say the reported descriptor is the SemiHonestOnly baseline with no axis promoted. Keep tamper-evident-with-abort strictly described as experimentally observed behavior, not a reported security tier, until sq-qhy4 closes.
issues.title: Public re-export commentary still claims an AXIS-2 security promotion

verdict.summary: Round 3 fixes the load-bearing code/API issue from round 2: equality_join_security now returns SemiHonestOnly, and the new guard test checks the adversary axis, legacy projection, and is_malicious_secure(). However, two public-facing source/documentation statements still say the path reports AXIS-2-only, directly contradicting the implementation and the repeated containment rationale that no axis may be promoted before sq-qhy4. Because this is the same active-security overclaim class at the same severity, progress is stagnant.
